notes: All five URLs return 200 anonymously without an Accept header or ?v= (2026-10-28). The layer.json has no "tilejson" member, so census.py (which requires "tilejson" in layer.json) will not tag qmesh.layer/qmesh.geodetic from the file; the covers tag carries it.
